jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Tidal Link Media is looking for a Project Coordinator to join our Culver City team and help keep the flow of goods, materials, and vendor relationships running smoothly from end to end. This role sits at the center of our supply chain operations, working closely with procurement, logistics, warehouse, and finance teams to make sure orders move on schedule and inventory stays accurate.

You will be the person who catches a delayed shipment before it becomes a production problem, who spots a discrepancy in inventory counts before it throws off a report, and who keeps vendor relationships steady even when timelines get tight. It is a role with real variety day to day, and one where your organization and follow\-through directly shape how smoothly the business runs.

As the team grows, this role has room to expand into broader ownership of vendor management, process design, and eventually a lead or senior coordinator track for the right person.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate and track incoming and outgoing shipments to ensure timely, accurate delivery
* Maintain accurate inventory records and lead regular cycle counts and audits
* Communicate directly with vendors and carriers to confirm order status, resolve discrepancies, and manage delays
* Create, track, and reconcile purchase orders, flagging issues before they affect operations
* Monitor supply levels and proactively flag potential shortages or overstock situations
* Partner with warehouse and logistics teams to streamline receiving and fulfillment processes
* Identify and help implement process improvements that increase efficiency and reduce cost
* Maintain organized, accessible documentation for shipments, contracts, and vendor communications
* Support cross\-functional projects tied to supply chain systems, vendor onboarding, or reporting improvements

What We Are Looking For

* 1 to 3 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, procurement, or a related coordination role
* Familiarity with inventory management systems and solid working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and shifting deadlines
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for working with vendors, carriers, and internal teams
* A proactive, detail\-oriented mindset with genuine comfort solving problems as they come up
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Logistics, or a related field preferred, though equivalent experience will be considered

Growth and Opportunities

* Direct exposure to how a growing media company manages procurement, logistics, and vendor strategy
* A clear path toward a senior coordinator or supply chain analyst role as the team scales
* Opportunities to take ownership of process improvement initiatives and systems projects
* Mentorship and regular feedback from experienced operations leadership
* Cross\-functional collaboration that builds visibility across procurement, finance, and warehouse operations

Why Join Tidal Link Media

* Competitive salary of $65,000 to $78,000, based on experience
* Hybrid work model that combines in\-office collaboration with flexibility
* A collaborative, low\-ego team environment where your work has a direct, visible impact
* Steady operational culture that values reliable execution as much as new ideas
* A company at a stage where you can help shape how supply chain processes are built, not just follow existing ones

Location: Culver City, CA

How to Apply: Interested candidates should submit their resume and a brief note on their relevant experience.

Tidal Link Media is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $50,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Life insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator Phlebotomy Trained
jobs.description:
Lightship is a clinical trial site organization delivering on\-site, hybrid, and virtual trials through a single, trusted partner. Our expanded reach model places each visit in the most practical setting, increasing access, strengthening enrollment and engagement, and improving representation across diverse communities.  

  

Our investigators and study teams follow participants across all visit types, supported by a unified SOP framework and shared technology backbone. This continuity preserves oversight, streamlines study conduct, and gives sponsors auditable visibility across the entire participant journey.  

  

With a growing footprint of eight physical sites and mobile research units (MRUs) that extend site capabilities into the community, Lightship increases access for participants who might otherwise be out of reach. Our 96 percent retention rate, 30\-plus sponsor audits, and multiple FDA engagements reflect a strong quality record that gives sponsors confidence in a reliable path to high\-performing trial execution.  

  

We’re building trial experiences that reflect real life: expanding reach, reducing burden, and bringing better therapies to market faster.

  

Position Summary


Lightship aims to bring life\-changing treatments to more patients in need by supporting community\-based clinics with clinical research resources.


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) to join our research team. The CRC will be responsible for the day\-to\-day coordination and execution of assigned clinical trials in accordance with study protocols, Good Clinical Practice (ICH E6(R3\)), applicable FDA regulations, IRB/IEC requirements, Lightship Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and applicable site or institutional requirements.


This position requires initiative, professionalism, strong organizational skills, and the ability to independently manage day\-to\-day study operations within appropriately trained, qualified, and delegated responsibilities while supporting appropriate oversight by the Principal Investigator (PI).


Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate and execute assigned clinical research studies from feasibility and study start\-up through study conduct and close\-out, including site feasibility support, regulatory activities, participant recruitment, study visits, data collection, follow\-up, and close\-out activities.
* Serve as a primary site contact for sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), IRBs/IECs, and study vendors, as appropriate. Coordinate and manage regulatory submissions, amendments, continuing reviews, responses to queries, and other study\-related submissions within delegated responsibilities.
* Independently manage day\-to\-day clinical trial operations within assigned and delegated responsibilities while maintaining appropriate communication with and supporting oversight by the Principal Investigator.
* Recruit and pre\-screen potential participants; perform protocol\-specific screening activities; support the informed consent process; obtain informed consent when appropriately trained, delegated, and permitted; and coordinate participant enrollment in accordance with the protocol, IRB\-approved documents, and applicable requirements.
* Coordinate participant study visits, retention, and follow\-up activities. Perform protocol\-required study procedures within the CRC’s documented training, qualifications, and delegated responsibilities.
* Perform and document phlebotomy, venipuncture, specimen collection, processing, storage, and shipment activities in accordance with the protocol, laboratory manual, applicable SOPs, and IATA/dangerous goods shipping requirements.
* Maintain complete, accurate, and inspection\-ready essential study records, including the Investigator Site File (ISF/eISF), delegation and training documentation, source documents, eSource/EHR records, case report forms (CRFs), electronic data capture (EDC) systems, and other required study documentation in accordance with Good Documentation Practices and data integrity requirements.
* Complete accurate and timely study data entry and review and facilitate timely resolution of data queries, discrepancies, missing information, and sponsor/monitor requests.
* Identify, document, and promptly escalate adverse events (AEs), serious adverse events (SAEs), protocol deviations, and other significant study issues to the Principal Investigator and appropriate study personnel. Support required safety and regulatory reporting within delegated responsibilities.
* Prepare for, coordinate, and support site qualification/pre\-study visits, site initiation visits, interim monitoring visits, close\-out visits, sponsor or quality audits, and regulatory inspections. Track and facilitate timely resolution of monitoring findings, audit observations, and action items.
* Perform delegated investigational product activities, as applicable, including receipt, storage, temperature monitoring, accountability, reconciliation, dispensing support, returns, and coordination with clinical pharmacies or other responsible personnel.
* Educate participants regarding study requirements, study medications or investigational product instructions as appropriate, visit schedules, study procedures, participant responsibilities, and whom to contact with study\-related questions or concerns.
* Protect participant privacy and confidentiality and handle clinical research records and information in accordance with applicable privacy requirements, study requirements, and Lightship policies.
* Manage study supplies, laboratory kits, specimen materials, shipping supplies, and other study\-specific materials, including inventory and expiration\-date tracking, as applicable.
* Track study recruitment, screening, enrollment, and retention activities and communicate study status, operational risks, barriers, and required escalations to the PI and appropriate study stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Morgan, Lewis \& Bockius LLP, one of the world’s leading global law firms with offices in strategic hubs of commerce, law, and government across North America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East, is seeking a Legal Administrative Coordinator (LAC) to support the Labor and Employment Practice Group. Reporting to the Administrative Support Manager, this position is responsible for providing a broad range of administrative, secretarial, and document processing support to the assigned Practice Groups under general guidance in an environment where superior client service is emphasized and consistently delivered.


Maintaining an in\-office presence is important to delivering our services and supports our integrated and collaborative work culture. Firm policy requires individuals in this role to work in the office three days per week, as scheduled by their manager, unless client demands or another accommodation approved by their practice group requires them to work elsewhere. This position will reside in our Los Angeles, CA office with a hybrid in\-office/remote working schedule. Flexibility to work overtime is required.


What You'll Do


* Regularly utilizes Task Delegation and Workflow Management software (BigHand) to receive, enter and update assignments; timely communicates with supervisor(s) through BigHand and/or directly the status of task completion and new developments that may impact the assignment and proactively seeks additional information or guidance when needed.
* Assists with word processing; edits and proofreads correspondence, memorandums, reports, and other general communications.
* Answers phones and takes messages, schedules appointments and coordinates meetings; arranges audio and video conferences; reserves conference rooms and arranges set\-ups.
* Maintains attorney calendar and advises attorney of appointments, updates attorney address book and InterAction entries.
* Performs redlining, prepare individual signature packets of closing documents, compile Exhibits and Schedules to documents, compile executed signatures of final documents.
* Assists with time entry.
* Processes new business intake, related forms, and correspondence.
* Processes expense reports and invoices; arranges check requests; monitors through completion.
* Arranges travel and prepares itineraries; maintains attorney travel and desk profiles.
* Coordinates or assists with printing, scanning, copying of documents and/or sending of same.
* Provides legal research, case support and project assistance.
* Other administrative duties as assigned.

Who we are looking for


* Bachelor’s degree and at least two (2\) years of administrative support experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Previous law firm experience required.
* Experience with supporting a Litigation practice, including State and Federal Court rules and filing procedures preferred.
* Demonstrates proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Portable Document Format (PDF) software.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, the ability to balance multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment, and the ability to manage confidential information with discretion.
* Excellent written/verbal communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to work autonomously while also functioning effectively in a team environment.
* Exhibits strategic thinking and initiative in handling assignments and projects.
* Works productively and effectively with all personnel as part of a client service team.

jobs.description:
**The opportunity**


We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented event professional to join our Global Events team. This AMER based role will manage the planning and execution of events, working closely with internal stakeholders from marketing, product, and sales teams to achieve goals and priorities for our Ads and Programmatic business in North America.


This person will own their assigned programs end to end \- from venue and vendor sourcing through registration, on\-site execution, and post\-event reporting. We're looking for a collaborative, organized self\-starter who loves live events and can keep several moving at once.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Own planning and execution of field marketing events across the Ads and Programmatic business \- trade shows, regional customer events, executive programs, and partner activations \- ensuring each experience aligns with business goals and reinforces brand values.
* Partner closely with Sales and Regional Marketing to support pipeline\-driving and demand\-generation events, adapting execution models to local market needs. Collaborate with Sales on event audience strategy, including invite lists, account prioritization, and follow\-up motions.
* Lead all planning and logistics, including venue sourcing and contracting, vendor and agency management, catering, transportation, A/V, and on\-site execution — coordinating timelines to keep deadlines on track and stakeholders informed.
* Own event registration and attendance tracking using event platforms, partnering with marketing operations to ensure accurate post\-event reporting, lead flow, and ROI measurement.
* Oversee event budgets for assigned programs, including purchase order creation, approvals, and reconciliation in partnership with Finance and Procurement, ensuring adherence to budgetary constraints.

**What we’re looking for**

* 5\+ years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, or experiential marketing, with a strong focus on sales\-aligned, pipeline\-driving programs.
* Proven experience working cross\-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Field Marketing, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors or agencies.
* Strong understanding of both ground\-level execution and strategic context – able to zoom in on logistics while keeping sight of broader business and marketing goals.
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple concurrent programs with shifting priorities.
* A proactive and detail\-oriented approach to problem\-solving. Someone who is adaptable as deliverables and requests change mid\-project.
* Ability to travel 30%

**You might also have**

* Experience in the tech or ads industry
* Experience working with CRM and marketing automation tools (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo) to support event follow\-up and reporting.

jobs.title: Social Post Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**BuzzFeed Studios** is looking for a project\-based Social Marketing Post Production Coordinator to join our team in Los Angeles. **We’re looking for a highly organized, production\-minded coordinator who can manage multiple social marketing projects and deliverables simultaneously, working across internal teams and freelance creative partners to take projects from kickoff through final delivery.**

This role will help manage the day\-to\-day production of social marketing assets, including tracking timelines and deliverables, coordinating editors and other creative resources, routing projects between internal departments, and supporting light editing, versioning, and exports as needed.

Rate: $260\-$350/day depending on experience

Location: Los Angeles, with the ability to work in office

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage social marketing projects from kickoff through final delivery, ensuring assets stay on schedule and meet project requirements
* Build, track and maintain project timelines, asset lists, deliverables, assignments, approvals, and final delivery status across multiple concurrent campaigns
* Partner with internal Marketing, Creative, Production, Post Production, and Social teams to coordinate project handoffs and ensure teams have the assets and information needed to complete their work
* Coordinate and resource freelance video editors and other creative support based on project needs, timelines, and available budgets
* Communicate project expectations, creative briefs, technical specifications, deadlines, and feedback to freelance and internal creative teams
* Maintain clear visibility into the status of all active social marketing deliverables and proactively flag risks, delays, missing assets, or resource constraints
* Facilitate review and feedback cycles between stakeholders, editors, designers, and other creative partners
* Organize and maintain source materials, project files, creative assets, feedback, and final deliverables
* Perform light video editing, versioning, resizing, captioning, and adjustments to existing creative as needed
* Export, Quality Control, and deliver final assets according to platform and campaign specifications
* Ensure final assets are properly named, organized, archived, and accessible to relevant teams
* Support multiple campaigns and projects simultaneously, adjusting priorities as timelines and business needs change

**Requirements:**

* 1–2 years of experience in digital media, social marketing, post production, creative operations, or a related field
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables simultaneously
* Experience coordinating video editors, freelancers, or other creative resources
* Working knowledge of social and digital video production, including platform\-specific formats and deliverables
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and Media Encoder with the ability to perform light edits, versioning, exports, and Quality Control
* Familiarity with codecs, image types, resolutions, frame rates as they pertain to digital media trends
* Experience with project management and tracking tools; Airtable and Float are a plus
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive with strong communication and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to independently guide projects from kickoff through final delivery in a fast\-paced, changing environment
* Knowledge of current social platforms, digital video trends, and entertainment marketing
* Positive, collaborative team player with a willingness to jump in where needed
* Open to working evenings, nights, and weekends as project needs require

Pay: $260\.00 \- $350\.00 per day

Ability to Commute:

* Los Angeles, CA 90038 (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90038

jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever\-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.


As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1\.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

**Job Description**
-------------------


The Client Account Manager/Executive is the strategic face of Payment Services to the client, representing multiple business channels. They are responsible for the overall management of a book of accounts, including maintenance, growth, increased profitability, strategic direction, overall client satisfaction, and contract renewals. Consults with clients through data analysis, industry education, presentation of performance results and recommending action to improve performance. Is the escalation point for both internal and external client issues.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Associate's degree, or equivalent work experience
* Typically two or more years of client management experience in payments industry

**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Strong contract negotiation, account management and project management skills
* Strong problem\-solving and negotiation skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects and deadlines simultaneously
* Ability to identify and resolve exceptions and to interpret data
* Proven customer service/relations skills
* Proficient computer navigation skills using a variety of software packages including Microsoft Office applications
* Strong presentation, interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills

**Additional Job Description:**


Responsible for managing a portfolio of clients with a focus on onboarding, retention, and growth. Key responsibilities include:

* Onboard and support newly activated accounts
* Build and maintain strong client relationships
* Increase portfolio profitability and client satisfaction
* Provide payment solutions education and consultative guidance
* Recommend products and services based on client needs
* Identify cross\-sell and growth opportunities
* Conduct proactive outreach to drive retention and engagement
* Leverage tools, campaigns, and insights to strengthen client relationships and business growth.

***The role offers a hybrid/flexible schedule, which means there's an in\-office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days.***

* Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
* Basic term and optional term life insurance
* Short\-term and long\-term disability
* Pregnancy disability and parental leave
* 401(k) and employer\-funded retirement plan
* Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)
* Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities
* Adoption assistance
* Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law

We are seeking an energetic Outside Sales Representative to drive business growth by developing new client relationships and managing existing accounts within the towing industry. This role offers an exciting opportunity to leverage your sales expertise, technical knowledge, and management skills to expand our market presence and deliver exceptional customer service.

We sell professional towing equipment to potential clients and businesses. We have systems in place ready for you to go after big deals. You can begin earning good income immediately within your first month if you are talented and persistent.

An average salesperson will earn $72K per year with us, while our best reps have earned $20k in a single month. We are not looking for average talent; we are looking for SUPERSTARS with the right potential and drive to be a TOP PRODUCER.

**Compensation:** 

Base salary of $1,000/month (average $60,000 to $120,000 or more annually)

* Preserve existing customers through consistent, systematic, and effective customer calls and visits.
* Acquire new accounts through prospecting, presenting and consistent follow\-through.

illi Commercial Real Estate is a premier property management and real estate services firm specializing in commercial properties. We provide comprehensive management solutions that enhance property value and tenant satisfaction.

**About The Role**

illi Commercial Real Estate is looking for a Marketing \& Digital Operations Specialist to support the planning, creation, execution, and analysis of marketing initiatives across email, digital advertising, social media, property marketing, CRM, website, video, and other marketing channels. This position offers considerable opportunities to leverage and develop skills in market research, branding and project management. Standard hours are 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM.

* Support the marketing department's initiatives with the planning, executing, and tracking of
* marketing programs including email campaigns, events, social media, content initiatives, and related marketing operations.

* Assist with integrations between CRM, email marketing, website forms, and other marketing systems.

* Assist with developing and managing content and marketing initiatives across multiple channels, including blogs and public relations efforts.
* Evaluate and monitor campaign performance on an ongoing basis by analyzing key metrics and creating comprehensive reports.
* Manage marketing operations, including reporting, performance tracking, and coordination ofmarketing assets across platforms, systems, and marketing channels.
* Manage and maintain marketing platforms, systems, and operational tools used by the marketing department.
* Assist in the development, documentation, and improvement of marketing workflows, procedures, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Provide guidance, training, or onboarding related to marketing tools, systems, and processes.

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.

* Experience creating professional marketing collateral and supporting digital, social, and email marketing initiatives.
* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud and working knowledge of CRM platforms such as Zoho CRM, Salesforce, or HubSpot.
* Experience with GA4 or similar web analytics tools and Excel and/or Google Sheets for marketing analytics and reporting.
* Familiarity with website content management systems, basic HTML, and collaboration or project management platforms such as WordPress, Google Workspace, and ClickUp.
* Experience using generative AI tools to support professional marketing activities.

**Core Competencies**

* **Marketing \& Digital Execution:** Understands marketing channels and best practices across digital, social, email, web, and marketing collateral.
* **Analytics \& Reporting:** Able to interpret marketing data, identify trends, measure performance, and translate metrics into useful reporting and insights.
* **Project Management:** Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, move projects forward independently, and meet deadlines.
* **Communication \& Content:** Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent copywriting, editing, and proofreading abilities.
* **Creativity \& Problem Solving:** Brings creative thinking to marketing initiatives while balancing brand standards, business needs, and practical execution.
* **Initiative \& Ownership:** Self\-directed and resourceful, with the ability to identify needs, take ownership, and follow projects through to completion.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

illi Commercial Real Estate offers a competitive total rewards package designed to support the health, well\-being, and professional growth of our employees. **Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, company holidays, and participation in a 401(k) retirement plan.** Additional benefits and programs may be available based on role and eligibility.

Employment with illi Commercial Real Estate is at\-will. This means that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

We're hiring **outgoing, motivated college students and recent graduates** to join our field sales team.

* **$17–$19/hour**

* **$600–$1,200\+ weekly earning potential** depending on schedule and performance

**Schedule:** Part\-Time \& Full\-Time

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - Independent Retail - Los Angeles
jobs.description:
Are you a current Associate? To be considered, you must submit your application through the internal Career Portal (Jobs Hub). Click here to access.


**Time Type:**


Full time**Remote Type:**

**Job Family Group:**


Sales**Job Description Summary:**

This position is designed as a sales development role and will rotate through a number of different territories. The primary responsibility for this position will be to fill in open territories as needed in order to maximize the sales of supplier brands to the trade. This position may be asked to assist the Merchandising Department during particularly heavy merchandising periods.**Job Description:**

**Job Responsibilities:**


Calls on accounts and covers daily routes by creating an established and efficient routing pattern.

* Prepares and delivers professional sales presentations to customers by balancing the company’s priorities and customer’s needs to include selling display ideas, new products, cold box, shelf, back bar placements and resets, drink and wine lists, and promotions.
* Maintains product levels in accounts by taking inventory and restocking shelves (where legal).
* Ensures maximum brand visibility within accounts by using effective and current point of sale materials when appropriate.
* Obtains payments for company by collecting and delivering checks or other remittance from accounts where legally permissible.
* Educates account staff by conducting educational staff training seminars on brands.
* Services accounts by delivering products to customers in extenuating circumstances, handling customer issues and complaints and referring these issues as appropriate to management.


Strategizes/preplans on how best to achieve sales and merchandising objectives by understanding company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintaining accurate historical account purchase information.

* Ensures national account compliance where applicable by accurately completing all necessary surveys.
* Understands the account’s buying patterns by reviewing the company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintains accurate historical account purchase information.
* Attains standards of performance goals by achieving the distribution, volume and activity goals of supplier brands as set by management.
* Manages customer account receivables by timely processing of credits and returns and communicating with accounts on aged receivables.
* Remains informed of company/supplier activities and updates by attending and actively participating in weekly sales meetings.


Other duties, as assigned by the jobholder’s supervisor, may also be required.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or equivalent training and work experience
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in sales
* Basic PC skills using MS Office and other various computer programs including presentation software
* Must be a results\-oriented professional with verbal/written communication skills using diplomacy and discretion as well as customer service skills
* Ability to multi\-task, work independently and/or within a team, pay attention to detail and meet deadlines
* Analytic and Reporting skills
* Utilize sound judgement and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work in fast\-paced, high\-volume, team environment
* Have a valid driver’s license

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ability to hold a Solicitor’s Permit
* Understanding of wine and spirits

**Physical Requirements:**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to, stand, sit; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to reach overhead, squat and bend
* Carrying and lifting 45\-65 pounds

**Competencies:**

* Accountable for results which impact the department.
* Selects best option from a set of defined procedures/ solutions using common sense and experience of similar situations.

*This job description is only a summary of the typical functions of this position, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible job responsibilities, tasks and duties. Responsibilities, tasks, and duties of individual jobholders may vary from the above description.*

***Salary and Benefit Statement:***


Any offered salary is determined based on internal equity, internal salary ranges, market data/ranges, applicant's skills, and prior relevant experience.

**Compensation**

* $45k \- $55k Salary
* Mileage Reimbursement at 70 cents per Business Miles driven

**Benefits**

* Medical (HMO \& PPO), Dental, Vision (PPO)401(k) matching.
* Annual PTO Accrual and holidays
* Rollover Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
* Free Life and AD\&D Insurance Employee Assistance Program

Whittier, CA, US, 90601

Job Description
  
  

Are you ready to launch your career in sales and be another reason Cintas, a growing Fortune 500 company, has been named to both FORTUNE’s World’s Most Admired Companies and Selling Power’s 60 Best Companies to Sell For? We start every day by asking how we can have an even greater impact: safer, cleaner, more efficient, better designed, and more sustainable. Our sensibilities and principles are rooted in always seeking to do better for our customers, for our partners, and for our planet.
  
Join employee\-partners who are recognized for being positive, respectful, motivated, and caring. These characteristics are an important part of our history and culture, and they are at the heart of everything we do.
  
That is why we are seeking a goal\-oriented, motivated, and energetic Sales Representative to join our growing Outside Sales team. This role provides our customers with solutions to their facility services needs by offering industry\-leading products and hands\-on help with the details of their workday. At Cintas, you will be building a successful, rewarding career while supporting our customers as they get Ready for the Workday™. In this business\-to\-business (B2B) sales role, you will apply the learnings from the Cintas Sales Training Program. This includes putting into practice valuable skills in cold\-calling, in\-person sales, product demonstrations, negotiations, objection\-handling, and closing.
  
As an Outside Sales team member, you will be responsible for prospecting, developing, and qualifying leads within your respective territory. You will utilize our CRM to identify, prospect, close new business and consistently achieve weekly sales goals and quotas.
  
  

**What We Offer:**  

* Salary \+ Monthly Commission: Competitive base salary with the potential to earn unlimited commission and a quarterly bonus based on performance.
* Extensive Car Package: A monthly car allowance/reimbursement, insurance, gas, and maintenance on your personal car.
* Hands\-on Training Program \& Certification: Comprehensive training and certification, ensuring you are set up for success.
* Monthly, Quarterly, \& Annual Recognition: Regular recognition, including Summit Events, President’s Club and other awards for your contributions and achievements.
* Limitless Career Advancement \& Mentorship Opportunities: Grow your career with clear paths for promotion and professional development.


**A Successful Candidate in This Role:**  

* Will be competitive, self\-motivated, and disciplined; strives to exceed all weekly, quarterly, and annual goals and expectations
* Will be collaborative; a team\-player who celebrates the victories of themselves and their team.
* Will be coachable; has a willingness to learn and an eagerness to take action.
* Will be ambitious and optimistic; displays a genuine interest, excitement, and eagerness toward the customers and work they champion.
* Will be confident and charismatic; has an innate interest in bringing ideas and solutions to life and presenting these ideas decisively.
* Will be customer\-focused; continuously meets and exceeds the needs of current and prospective customers.
* Will be a solution\-centric advisor; a forward\-thinking problem\-solver focused on customer satisfaction and results.


Skills/Qualifications
  
  

**Required:**  

* High School diploma or GED
* Valid driver’s license
* Proficiency with MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), intranet/internet and Contact Management System (CMS)


**Preferred:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field
* Prior sales experience (1 year\+), preferably in a similar role
* Prior new business\-to\-business (B2B) sales experience


We are committed to your success and well\-being, offering a dynamic environment with unparalleled benefits and career growth potential. Join us today!
  
  

Benefits
  
Cintas offers comprehensive and competitive medical, dental and vision benefits, with premiums below the national average. We offer flexibility with four different medical plan options; one plan is offered at zero cost.
  
  

**Additionally, our employee\-partners enjoy:**  

* Competitive Pay
* 401(k) with Company Match/Profit Sharing/Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Disability, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 100% Company Paid
* Paid Time Off and Holidays
* Skills Development, Training and Career Advancement Opportunities


Compensation
  
A reasonable estimate of total compensation for this role ranges between $70,304 \- $150,000/Year and is a combination of base salary plus earned commissions. The range takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, performance, and other business and organization needs. This disclosed range has not been adjusted for applicable geographic differentials associated with the location at which the position may be filled. Please note, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decision are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each decision.

Cintas Corporation helps more than one million businesses of all types and sizes get Ready™ to open their doors with confidence every day by providing products and services that help keep their customers’ facilities and employees clean, safe, and looking their best. With offerings including uniforms, mats, mops, towels, restroom supplies, workplace water services, first aid and safety products, eye\-wash stations, safety training, fire extinguishers, sprinkler systems and alarm service, Cintas helps customers get Ready for the Workday®. jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for **making a difference for small business** in your community? Are you looking for a career with **unlimited income potential**? Is **company culture** important to you? Or maybe you have been thinking about switching career paths and moving into sales?

**NFIB was chosen as a Glassdoor Top 50 Best Places to Work.** A sales career with NFIB provides **money, mission, mobility,** and a culture that fosters teamwork and collaboration. Whether you have some sales experience or are new to sales, NFIB will set you up for success with best\-in\-class training. **A career with NFIB provides a flexible work/life balance while still maintaining full\-time effort in the field.**  

We are seeking individuals who are results\-focused, with an **entrepreneurial spirit**, and exceptional work ethic to prospect, conduct face\-to\-face cold calls, and enroll new members.


***What’s in it for you:**** **W\-2 with full benefits** (medical, dental, vision, matching 401k, and more) \- **eligible after 30 days**
* **Up to 13 weeks** (1,000/wk) **performance\-based training pay** (or commission, whichever is greater)
* **Production\-based weekly commissions, monthly \& quarterly bonuses**
* **Yearly average compensation: $80,000 \- $200,000**
* **40%** of our sales force **earns 6\-figures** with the **top 10%** earning **over 200k**
* **UNCAPPED earning potential** (Straight Commission)
* **Monthly Mileage reimbursement**

***Who we are*****:**

**NFIB is the most trusted advocate for free enterprise**, promoting and protecting the rights of any individual to own, operate, and grow their business. **NFIB's advocacy has a profound impact on shaping public policies** by influencing


decision\-makers, raising awareness, and mobilizing public support. NFIB membership is the mechanism for small business owners to actively contribute to the development of policies that align with their values and concerns. **NFIB has been fighting for independent business owners** for over 80 years. We are the **Voice of Small Business** in Washington, D.C., and in all 50 state capitals. **NFIB is a nonprofit, nonpartisan, and member driven** organization.

  

We educate small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting) using NFIB's success\-proven verbatim sales presentation. This is a hunter/closer sales position using an assumptive one\-call close with no account management after the sale. ***What you will be responsible for:**** Meeting small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting)
* Memorizing and utilizing NFIB’s proven 5\-minute verbatim sales presentation
* Building quick rapport and delivering an engaging presentation
* Overcoming objections and closing the sale

Processing payment on the spot  
* 

  

***Requirements to win in this role:**** Strong work ethic
* Grit and relentless perseverance
* Self\-starter and ability to stick with a structured, proven sales model
* Desire for ongoing learning
* Quick\-witted, adaptable, and strategic
* Passion for the success of small business
* Sales experience **AND/OR** transferable skills
* Intermediate technical skills


A career with NFIB means being part of a team of truly extraordinary people working to promote and protect small business. You will be impacting your community while taking advantage of our competitive compensation, ongoing training, incentives, and generous benefits package. **Learn more about the NFIB’s culture here:** www.nfib.com/careers


Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Client Services and Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**United Behavior Consultants (UBC)** is seeking a reliable, organized, and personable **Client Services \& Administrative Coordinator** to join our growing ABA team. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with families, coordinating schedules, supporting a busy clinical team, and keeping day\-to\-day administrative operations running smoothly.

The Client Services \& Administrative Coordinator will serve as one of the first points of contact for clients, families, employees, and visitors. This individual will provide exceptional customer service while assisting with scheduling, administrative tasks, communication, and office coordination.

**Position ResponsibilitiesClient Services \& Communication**

· Serve as a friendly and professional point of contact for clients, families, employees, and visitors.

· Answer and direct incoming phone calls, emails, and general inquiries.

· Greet clients, families, and visitors in a professional and welcoming manner.

· Communicate with families regarding scheduling, appointments, cancellations, and general administrative questions.

· Maintain professional and compassionate communication with families, particularly when addressing scheduling changes or concerns.

· Direct clinical or service\-related questions to the appropriate clinical team member.

· Maintain confidentiality of client and employee information in accordance with HIPAA and company policies.

**Scheduling \& Coordination**

· Assist with coordinating and maintaining client and staff schedules.

· Communicate scheduling changes with Behavior Technicians, BCBAs, families, and other team members.

· Assist with filling scheduling gaps, cancellations, and coverage needs.

· Track schedule changes and ensure appropriate communication between team members.

· Assist with coordinating staff availability and client service schedules.

· Identify scheduling conflicts and communicate them to the appropriate supervisor.

· Maintain accurate scheduling records within company systems.

**Administrative Support**

· Provide general administrative support to the clinical and administrative teams.

· Assist with data entry, document organization, scanning, filing, and maintaining electronic records.

· Prepare and organize paperwork and administrative materials.

· Assist with onboarding\-related administrative tasks as assigned.

· Maintain office supplies and assist with ordering supplies when needed.

· Assist with mail, deliveries, and general office organization.

· Support company meetings, events, and other administrative projects.

· Complete other administrative duties as assigned.

**Office \& Team Support**

· Help maintain a professional, organized, and welcoming office environment.

· Assist team members with administrative needs and routine questions.

· Work collaboratively with the scheduling, clinical, HR, billing, and administrative departments.

· Escalate client or employee concerns appropriately to the appropriate supervisor or department.

· Follow all company policies, procedures, HIPAA requirements, and confidentiality standards.

**Qualifications**

· High school diploma or equivalent required.

· Previous experience in an administrative, receptionist, customer service, scheduling, healthcare, education, or behavioral health setting preferred.

· Experience working in an ABA, healthcare, therapy, or other service\-based organization is a plus.

· Strong organizational and time\-management skills.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

· Professional and friendly demeanor.

· Ability to communicate effectively with parents, employees, and management.

· Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

· Ability to multitask and prioritize responsibilities in a fast\-paced environment.

· Comfortable using computers, email, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and scheduling or database systems.

· Ability to maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive client and employee information.

· Must be dependable, punctual, and able to work effectively as part of a team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Experience coordinating schedules for multiple employees or clients.

· Experience working with children and families.

· Experience in ABA, behavioral health, healthcare, or a related field.

· Familiarity with HIPAA and client confidentiality requirements.

· Experience with electronic medical records, ABA software, or scheduling platforms.

**Schedule**

**Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM**

Full\-time position.

Compensation

**$24\.00–$27\.00 per hour**, depending on experience and qualifications.

**Benefits**

· Medical, dental, and vision insurance

· Paid holidays

· Vacation/PTO after 1 year of employment

· 401(k) plan after 1 year of employment

· Professional and supportive work environment

· Opportunities for growth within the organization

Why Join United Behavior Consultants?

At UBC, we believe that strong administrative support is an essential part of providing high\-quality services to our clients and families. Our administrative team plays an important role in helping our clinicians and Behavior Technicians provide consistent and effective care.

If you are organized, dependable, compassionate, and enjoy helping people while keeping things running smoothly, we would love to hear from you!

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

RobotX AI Inc. is an AI robotics company focused on bringing intelligent robots into real\-world commercial and industrial environments. We work with humanoid robots, quadruped robots, service robots, and other intelligent robotic platforms, supporting demonstrations, testing, deployment, and automation solutions across North America.

We are seeking a reliable, organized, and detail\-oriented **Full\-Time Administrative Coordinator** to support our Irvine office. This position will be responsible for daily office administration, scheduling, document management, customer reception, and internal coordination.

The ideal candidate is professional, proactive, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and interested in working in a fast\-paced AI robotics startup environment.

Responsibilities

* Support daily office administration and internal operations.
* Coordinate meetings, appointments, calendars, and company schedules.
* Welcome customers, visitors, vendors, and business partners.
* Prepare meeting rooms and assist with customer visits.
* Manage incoming emails, phone calls, packages, and deliveries.
* Organize digital files, business records, documents, and office supplies.
* Prepare presentations, spreadsheets, reports, and other business documents.
* Perform data entry and maintain internal administrative trackers.
* Assist with purchasing, expense records, invoices, and vendor communication.
* Follow up on administrative requests and assigned tasks.
* Coordinate with internal team members and external business partners.
* Support company meetings, events, trade shows, and customer demonstrations.
* Assist management with additional administrative and operational tasks as needed.

Qualifications

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional and friendly when interacting with customers and visitors.
* Proficient with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
* Comfortable learning new software and internal systems.
* Reliable, responsible, and able to manage multiple priorities.
* Able to work independently and follow through on assigned tasks.
* Previous experience in administration, office coordination, operations, customer service, or a related position is preferred.
* Mandarin Chinese proficiency is a plus.
* Interest in AI, robotics, technology, or startups is a plus.
* Must be able to work on\-site in Irvine, California.

Schedule

* Full\-time
* Approximately 40 hours per week
* Monday through Friday
* Regular business hours

What We Offer

* Hands\-on experience working at a growing AI robotics company.
* Professional development assistance.
* Exposure to business operations, robotics products, and customer projects.
* Opportunity to work with both business and technical teams.
* Opportunity for increased responsibilities based on performance and company needs.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Social Media Manager to own social strategy and performance for Bedrosians — growing our engagement and community. You'll set content direction, turn performance data into next steps, and manage a growing network of creators, influencers, and designers, including partnerships and collaborations.


Our in\-house creative team will assist with direction and production; you bring the platform expertise and performance rigor that shape what that creative needs to accomplish. You'll also shoot and edit native content yourself when needed. You'll partner closely with creative and internal teams, and coordinate with our paid social agency to keep organic and paid aligned.

**PLEASE NOTE: This role is an on\-site M\-F located in Tustin, CA. We do not offer remote or hybrid options. Please do not apply if you cannot be present on\-site M\-F.**

  

**Compensation:**
$100,000 – $125,000

 **Responsibilities:****Social Strategy \& Performance**

* Build and own the social strategy end\-to\-end — audience growth, engagement, conversion, and retention — with clear goals and KPIs at every stage.
* Turn platform, campaign, and site data into concrete, actionable recommendations for content, targeting, and creative direction — insights that change what gets made, not just a monthly readout.
* Design and run an ongoing testing program across hooks, formats, messaging, and posting cadence, and use results to continuously refine the plan.
* Report performance on a regular cadence, connecting social activity to business outcomes — traffic, leads, conversion, and retention.

**Content Planning \& Native Execution**

* Own the content calendar and day\-to\-day publishing cadence across Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and emerging platforms.
* Partner with the creative team on campaign concepts, translating brand and business priorities into clear content briefs — they lead art direction and production; you make sure the output is platform\-native and on\-strategy.
* Shoot and edit lighter, fast\-turnaround native content (behind\-the\-scenes, trend\-driven, UGC\-style) as needed, working within the creative team's established visual direction rather than setting it independently.
* Write and adapt captions and copy to match intent — from brand storytelling to conversion\-focused copy.

**Creator, Influencer \& Designer Partnerships**

* Source, onboard, and manage a network of UGC creators, influencers, and designers who reflect Bedrosians' credibility with both trade pros and homeowners.
* Own influencer and designer collaborations end\-to\-end — outreach, negotiation, briefing, and execution.
* Write clear, performance\-oriented briefs and keep a steady pipeline of creator and partner content for testing.
* Track creator\- and partner\-level performance and double down on what drives results.

**Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Work side by side with the Creative Director and creative team as the strategy and performance counterpart to their creative leadership.
* Partner with paid social, e\-commerce, and trade marketing to align organic and paid strategy and keep creative fresh.
* Coordinate with the paid social agency to identify organic content worth amplifying and flag where creative is starting to fatigue.

 **Qualifications:**
7–10 years of experience in social media strategy, management, or performance marketing, with a track record of owning results — not just output.

* Demonstrated ability to connect content to real business outcomes — not just engagement, but traffic, conversion, and repeat business.
* Strong analytical ability; comfortable pulling insights from platform analytics, GA4, or similar tools and turning them into content and strategy decisions.
* Experience partnering with a creative team or art director to execute campaigns, including writing briefs and giving platform\-informed feedback.
* Working knowledge of TikTok, Instagram/Meta, Pinterest, and emerging platforms, plus hands\-on experience with a social scheduling/management tool such as Sprout Social or Dash Social.
* Experience building and managing creator, influencer, and designer partnerships — outreach, negotiation, briefing, and rights management.
* Strong copywriting instincts, able to move between brand storytelling and conversion\-focused copy.
* Excellent organizational skills — able to manage a content calendar, creator relationships, and cross\-functional stakeholders at once without things slipping.

**Nice to Have**

* A background or genuine interest in interior design, home furnishings, or a related lifestyle/design category — an eye for interiors and materials is a plus, though not required.
* Basic native content shooting/editing skills (iPhone video, CapCut, or similar) for fast\-turnaround content.
* Experience in home, building products, or another considered\-purchase DTC category.

 **About Company**  

Since 1948, Bedrosians have been a trusted leader in tile and stone. With 40\+ showrooms across the country, a direct\-to\-consumer site, and strong relationships with designers, contractors, and retailers, we are investing in the future of omnichannel marketing to deliver seamless and inspiring customer experiences.

**Job Description**

**Position Title:** Program Coordinator\- Strategic Partnerships \& Policy (FSA)

**Department:** Strategic Partnerships \& Policy (SPP)

**Reports to:** Senior Program Manager of Community Systems \& Partnerships

**Location:** 3450 Third Street, Building 2, San Francisco, CA 94124

**ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION**

Safe \& Sound's mission is to prevent and reduce the impact of childhood abuse, neglect, and trauma. We do this by strengthening families, building communities, and advancing healing, equity, and justice. We envision a future free from childhood trauma, where all children, families, and communities are safe, supported, and loved.

Combining direct services, training and capacity building, research, and advocacy to strengthen families in their communities, address childhood trauma, and prevent abuse, Safe \& Sound has evolved into a premiere child\-serving organization, bringing over 50 years of service to our community.

We reach more than 11,000 caregivers and children annually with our unique coordinated, multi\-generational approach that spans the entire spectrum of prevention and intervention to strengthen family resilience and address factors that put families at risk for experiencing abuse or involvement in unsubstantiated abuse allegations.

The organization has an annual operating budget of approximately $10\.8 million and is supported by approximately 55 staff, interns, and more than 100 volunteers. Safe \& Sound headquarters is located in a historic firehouse in the Haight\-Ashbury neighborhood of San Francisco, with a second office in the Bayview neighborhood.

More information is available at: www.safeandsound.org

**OVERALL SUMMARY**

Safe \& Sound serves as the backbone organization for the Family Services Alliance (FSA), a coalition of 44 San Francisco community\-based organizations — including 26 Family Resource Centers — that collectively serve more than 51,000 families each year. As the FSA has grown in scope, particularly around referral technology platforms, Medi\-Cal involvement, and cross\-sector partnership coordination, the day\-to\-day coordination work has increasingly been absorbed by senior staff whose time is better spent on supervision, policy, and systems\-level work.

The Program Coordinator\-Strategic Partnerships \& Policy (FSA) is a new role created to provide dedicated operational capacity to the SPP team in their FSA backbone and cross\-sector systems change work.

The Program Coordinator focuses exclusively on coordination, implementation, and communications — ensuring that convenings run smoothly, member organizations are supported and connected, grant deliverables are tracked, and the broader field stays informed. * Support member outreach and engagement by tracking contacts and data, building relationships with partners, and preparing senior staff for meetings.

**Communications \& Design**

**Data \& Technology**

jobs.description:
### **Role Summary**


Are you an organized, compassionate, and detail\-oriented professional who excels at providing seamless administrative support in a vibrant care environment? We are seeking an energetic **Center Coordinator – Adult Day Program** to support operational excellence and foster a warm, inclusive community for older adults.


In this dynamic, key support role, you will work under the supervision of the Adult Day Program Manager to ensure smooth daily center operations, including activity logistics, caregiver scheduling, transportation routing, and electronic recordkeeping. You will serve as an essential ambassador for our patients and community members, championing a welcoming, empowering environment with a strong commitment to serving diverse populations, including LGBTQ seniors. If you thrive in an engaging, fast\-paced setting and love helping others, we encourage you to apply!

### **Duties \& Responsibilities**

#### **Operations \& Care Coordination**

* **Center Administration:** Provide broad administrative and operational support across daily program activities, meal services, personal care scheduling, intake needs, and patient/staff safety protocols.
* **Caregiver Team Support:** Collaborate with program management to assist in overseeing the caregiver team, including coordinate scheduling and daily workflow support.
* **Transportation \& Scheduling:** Coordinate transportation logistics and routing to ensure patients arrive safely and on time for program activities.
* **Documentation \& Data Entry:** Maintain accurate electronic records, complete required Electronic Health Record (EHR) data entry, and generate operational reports as requested.
* **Inclusive Environment:** Champion an inclusive, welcoming culture for all patients and community members, demonstrating sensitivity to diversity and intersectionality within the community.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnering:** Work collaboratively with management and center staff to enhance program quality, operational efficiency, and overall team success.
* **Frontline Engagement:** Serve as a warm, professional point of contact for patients, families, and visiting partners, assisting with basic translation or interpretation as needed if bilingual.
* **Compliance \& Safety:** Maintain a clean, orderly workspace and comply with all administrative, safety, background clearance, and health screening protocols (including TB testing).
* Other duties as assigned.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education \& Certifications**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
* **Age Requirement:** Must be at least 18 years of age.
* **Certifications:** Active CPR and First Aid Certifications (required upon hire).
* **Clearances:** Ability to clear a standard background check and obtain required medical clearances (including health screening and TB test).

#### **Experience \& Technical Skills**

* **Administrative Background:** Minimum of one (1\) year of administrative, coordinator, or office support experience.
* **Computer Proficiency:** Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite, electronic scheduling systems, EHR platforms, and standard office technology.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a warm, professional, and patient\-centered demeanor.
* **Adaptability \& Organization:** Highly organized with exceptional multi\-tasking skills, able to prioritize effectively in a busy environment with frequent interruptions.

### **Desired Qualifications**

* **Community Specialty:** 2 to 4 years of experience working in healthcare, adult day care, or senior care settings, with a preferred focus or demonstrated interest in serving LGBTQ seniors.
* **Bilingual Ability:** Fluency in a second language is a strong plus (capable of providing basic translation for patients and staff).

### **Location and Work Type**

* **Work Type:** Full\-Time Position (Contract).
* **Work Setting:** On\-Site Ambulatory/Day Center Environment.
* **Schedule:** Full\-time (Monday– Friday \- shift schedule).

**I strive to reply within 48 hours. Looking forward to connecting with you soon. Thank you!**

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

**About the Role**


Replit is experiencing extraordinary growth across our customer base and seeking a Mid\-Market Account Manager with strong communication skills to drive retention, expansion, and customer success. Candidates with Sales or Account Management experience in SaaS, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.

  

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client\-facing situations and have a passion for customer success and AI. You'll leverage your skills to help customers maximize value from Replit's platform while driving sustainable revenue growth.

 **In this role you will:**

* Execute renewal processes with a focus on expansion and long\-term partnership development
* Serve as the primary relationship owner for your assigned customer portfolio, ensuring high satisfaction and retention
* Champion customer success by helping businesses realize the transformative potential of AI\-powered software creation
* Lead onboarding programs that accelerate customer time\-to\-value and platform adoption
* Guide customers through Replit's rapidly evolving feature set, including Agent 3's autonomous capabilities, Plan Mode, and automation tools
* Maintain accurate customer health scores and renewal forecasting data in Replit's CRM (Hubspot)
* Gather and communicate valuable customer feedback, championing their interests within Replit
* Optimize customers' use of the Replit platform through ongoing training, support, and strategic guidance

 **Required skills and experience:**

* 3\-5\+ years in a quota\-carrying Sales or Account Management role managing a mid\-market book in SaaS or developer tools
* Proven ability to expand product usage while growing your book of business and triaging renewal risk
* Track record of consistently hitting renewal and expansion targets across a multi\-account portfolio
* Experience blending product\-led signals (usage/adoption data) with direct selling
* Comfort owning a number: forecasting accurately, managing pipeline across dozens of accounts, and closing deals ranging from quick renewals to larger negotiated expansions
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to sell technical value to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Proficiency in using CRM systems and customer success tools (e.g., Hubspot)
* Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies to diverse customer segments
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a consultative approach to uncovering expansion opportunities
* Passion for AI/automation and staying current with industry trends
* Comfort with data analysis, especially product usage data, to identify growth signals and prioritize outreach

 **Nice to have:**

* You're an active Replit user
* You've worked at an early\-stage startup or in developer tools
* Experience with rapid prototyping, product development workflows, or business process automation
* Background in customer success at companies serving technical or semi\-technical user bases
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

 **Tools \+ Tech Stack for this role:**

* Replit
* Hubspot CRM
* Customer success and analytics platforms
* ZoomInfo
* LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Hashboard, Hex
* Various customer communication and project management tools

 **This role may** ***not*** **be a fit if:**

* You're not passionate about helping customers succeed and driving long\-term relationships
* You lack an understanding of the software development lifecycle or have little interest in learning about technical workflows
* You're not excited about AI and its potential to transform how businesses operate
* You don't enjoy being in client\-facing roles where 80% of your day is talking to customers
* You prefer transactional interactions over building deep, strategic relationship

 *This is a full\-time role that can be held from our NYC office. This role has an in\-office requirement.*

**Full\-Time Employee Benefits Include:**


Competitive Salary \& Equity


401(k) Program with a 4% match (*US Only*)


Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance


Short Term and Long Term Disability


Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave


Flexible Time Off (FTO) \+ Holidays


Commuter Benefits (*In\-Office \& US Only*)


Monthly Wellness Stipend


Autonomous Work Environment


In Office Set\-Up Reimbursement (*In\-Office Only*)


Quarterly Team Gatherings


In Office Amenities (*In\-Office Only*)

**Want to learn more about what we are up to?**

* Self\-driving Company
* Replit Agent at Scale
* AI Adoption
* Build Open\-Source Apps

 **Interviewing \+ Culture at Replit**

* Operating Principles
* Reasons not to work at Replit

We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non\-traditional backgrounds.

**Position Summary**



The Sales Representative is responsible for leading territory sales, developing and executing strategic sales plans, and driving revenue growth in the with a variety of minor metal using customers.



The Sales Representative will help drive sales for Vital Materials’ Functional Materials division of metal products in the United States territory. These materials include Bismuth, Selenium, Cadmium, Cobalt, and Indium based metals. Forms include, ingots, powders, liquids, oxides and more.



This role will focus on expanding market share, building strong customer relationships, and ensuring alignment between sales goals and overall business objectives. The Sales Representative will leverage deep industry knowledge to identify new opportunities, optimize pricing strategies, and strengthen the company’s competitive position.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Strategic Leadership \& Planning**


* Develop and implement a comprehensive sales strategy aligned with the company’s growth objectives.
* Identify and evaluate new market segments, product opportunities, and geographic expansion strategies.
* Set annual sales goals, budgets, and performance targets, ensuring consistent achievement of revenue objectives.


**Business Development \& Customer Engagement**


* Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, and strategic partners.
* Oversee key account management, ensuring customer satisfaction, retention, and growth.
* Negotiate major contracts and pricing agreements with customers.


**Market \& Industry Expertise**


* Stay informed about market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and new technologies in chemical manufacturing.
* Collaborate with marketing, R\&D, and operations teams to ensure product offerings meet market needs.
* Provide input into product development and innovation initiatives based on customer feedback and market demands.


**Sales Operations \& Reporting**


* Monitor sales performance through KPIs, pipeline management, and forecasting accuracy.
* Prepare regular reports for executive leadership on sales metrics, competitive intelligence, and market opportunities.
* Oversee CRM usage and data integrity to support decision\-making and account management.


**Qualifications**


**Education \& Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Business Administration, or related field
* 2\+ years of sales experience in chemicals, food ingredients, metals, or closely related industries.


**Skills \& Competencies**


* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent negotiation, presentation, and communication abilities.
* Deep understanding of metal and chemical manufacturing processes, products, and market dynamics.
* Strategic thinker with analytical problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in CRM systems, sales analytics, and Microsoft Office Suite.

  


**Work Environment \& Travel**

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry\-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for **making a difference for small business** in your community? Are you looking for a career with **unlimited income potential**? Is **company culture** important to you? Or maybe you have been thinking about switching career paths and moving into sales?

**NFIB was chosen as a Glassdoor Top 50 Best Places to Work.** A sales career with NFIB provides **money, mission, mobility,** and a culture that fosters teamwork and collaboration. Whether you have some sales experience or are new to sales, NFIB will set you up for success with best\-in\-class training. **A career with NFIB provides a flexible work/life balance while still maintaining full\-time effort in the field.**  

We are seeking individuals who are results\-focused, with an **entrepreneurial spirit**, and exceptional work ethic to prospect, conduct face\-to\-face cold calls, and enroll new members.


***What’s in it for you:**** **W\-2 with full benefits** (medical, dental, vision, matching 401k, and more) \- **eligible after 30 days**
* **Up to 13 weeks** (1,000/wk) **performance\-based training pay** (or commission, whichever is greater)
* **Production\-based weekly commissions, monthly \& quarterly bonuses**
* **Yearly average compensation: $80,000 \- $200,000**
* **40%** of our sales force **earns 6\-figures** with the **top 10%** earning **over 200k**
* **UNCAPPED earning potential** (Straight Commission)
* **Monthly Mileage reimbursement**

***Who we are*****:**

**NFIB is the most trusted advocate for free enterprise**, promoting and protecting the rights of any individual to own, operate, and grow their business. **NFIB's advocacy has a profound impact on shaping public policies** by influencing


decision\-makers, raising awareness, and mobilizing public support. NFIB membership is the mechanism for small business owners to actively contribute to the development of policies that align with their values and concerns. **NFIB has been fighting for independent business owners** for over 80 years. We are the **Voice of Small Business** in Washington, D.C., and in all 50 state capitals. **NFIB is a nonprofit, nonpartisan, and member driven** organization.

  

We educate small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting) using NFIB's success\-proven verbatim sales presentation. This is a hunter/closer sales position using an assumptive one\-call close with no account management after the sale. ***What you will be responsible for:**** Meeting small business owners through in\-person prospecting (no appointment setting)
* Memorizing and utilizing NFIB’s proven 5\-minute verbatim sales presentation
* Building quick rapport and delivering an engaging presentation
* Overcoming objections and closing the sale

Processing payment on the spot  
* 

  

***Requirements to win in this role:**** Strong work ethic
* Grit and relentless perseverance
* Self\-starter and ability to stick with a structured, proven sales model
* Desire for ongoing learning
* Quick\-witted, adaptable, and strategic
* Passion for the success of small business
* Sales experience **AND/OR** transferable skills
* Intermediate technical skills


A career with NFIB means being part of a team of truly extraordinary people working to promote and protect small business. You will be impacting your community while taking advantage of our competitive compensation, ongoing training, incentives, and generous benefits package. **Learn more about the NFIB’s culture here:** www.nfib.com/careers


Equal Opportunity Employer
